item.title: Video-game tournament organizer reinstates Jewish pro player after lawsuit

item.title: Americans more sympathetic to Palestinians than Israelis for first time in Gallup poll
item.description: 41% of Americans answer “Palestinians” to the question “in the Middle East situation, are your sympathies more with the Israelis or more with the Palestinians?” Just 36% say their sympathies are more with Israelis.
